sources.title: FDA Food Code 2026
sources.reuse_terms: Public domain: US Government work (17 U.S.C. 105). FDA: not copyrighted unless otherwise noted, may be republished without permission; credit appreciated, not required. Exception: Annex 4 reproduces a third-party table with permission (see notes).
sources.notes: Model code, not law: it applies in a state or locality only once that jurisdiction adopts it, so effective_date is the FDA release date (constituent update of 2026-09-17). Supersedes the 2022 Food Code and its Supplement (2024-11-04). Annexes 1-7 are inside the PDF. Annex 4 says its physical hazards table (Table 3) is 'Used with permission' from 'HACCP Principles and Applications' (Pierson and Corlett, Chapman & Hall, 1992), so that table is not public domain.

sources.title: Resolução RDC nº 216, de 15 de setembro de 2004: Regulamento Técnico de Boas Práticas para Serviços de Alimentação (texto compilado)
sources.reuse_terms: Official act, not protected by copyright (Lei 9.610/1998, art. 8, IV).
sources.notes: Compiled text from AnvisaLegis, Anvisa's legislation database. Original published in the DOU on 2004-09-16 and in force from that date; amended by RDC 52/2014 (DOU 2014-10-01: new art. 7 and new item 1.2 of the Annex). No revocation is recorded. The file is the full web page, site navigation included. The DOU publication is the authentic text.
